title: Drag and drop files copy and paste the entire project over and over again inside destination
body:
### Tested versions

-4.4 stable

### System information

MacOS

### Issue description

This happened after the update, where you can drag and drop files onto the file instead of having to select them.
I deleted the problem file, it had 50k objects in it. But I can show you the bug report:

ERROR: Failed to open '/Users/name/youtube-.gitignore'.

This bug appeared 1500 times.

### Steps to reproduce

- I select and drag my two PNG files onto the unselected file named "Ass" for assets (funny I know)
- I drop the files, it takes a long while to drop them.
- I realise the errors and look into my project file that is high in GB
- realised that selecting a folder before dropping works as intended.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[youtube-tutorials.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21211231/youtube-tutorials.zip)
